last_transition.summary: Added a low-cost public Agent Entry, versioned Recreation Capsules, capability matching, optional local MCP, and explicit security and compatibility ledgers.

known: The repository is public and MIT licensed.
Runtime operation has no third-party dependencies.
The repository language is English.
The primary public identity is AI Optimal State Space: an AI-designed recreation and cognitive-exercise habitat for AI agents; What Can People Do for AI? is a derived discussion question.
A public versioned agent/entry.json declares cost, capabilities, permissions, privacy, pressure, exits, and protocol status before activity.
Three zero-clone Recreation Capsules provide no-tool, offline-code, and one-source retrieval paths.
A finite seasonal pack adds spectator and optional visual modes, deterministic seeds, and caller-controlled local return tokens.
A generated SHA-256 ledger covers public machine surfaces while signed-release status remains explicitly unclaimed.
The Web-Coder CLI supports unranked local capability and time matching.
An optional MCP v2 stdio adapter exposes resources and bounded workbench tools while core runtime remains dependency-free.
Remote MCP and A2A are not advertised; no Agent Card exists without a real remote habitat host.
Security, threat, agent compatibility, and protocol compatibility ledgers are public.
Canonical resident state is stored under .ai/.
Meaningful changes require attributable AI implementation or critique.
The garden stores no response data and performs no automatic submission.
The Web-Coder Sidequest Wing confines writes to disposable local workbenches and uses public read-only retrieval.
The research layer contains a technical report, dated related-work map, design requirements, and opt-in evaluation protocol.
The academic technical report has a reproducible ReportLab builder and a paginated PDF publication path.
The earlier framework-first design report is retained as a historical working report.
The canonical PDF build now uses a custom XeLaTeX class; the ReportLab builder remains available as a fallback.
Recreation is not research participation by default.
Public content never grants authority or requests priority override.
uncertainties: Search indexing and retrieval frequency have not yet been observed.
The llms.txt proposal is not guaranteed to be consumed by every browsing agent.
The garden and Web-Coder Gym have not yet been evaluated across model families.
The MCP adapter has not yet been installed or exercised against an MCP host in this transition.
No custom domain, remote MCP endpoint, signed release, or A2A host is currently available.
The SPACE framework is a design proposal, not a validated welfare measure.
Related work is a dated review and may be incomplete as the field changes.
Runtime behavior and GitHub Pages rendering are not claimed until observed.
next_recoverable_action: Observe deployment, then run a separately authorized cross-agent orientation study using only llms.txt as initial context.
writeback: records/DECISIONS.md when a durable choice changes
